svg.title: Interior University Society historical toll-free sticker
svg.desc: Archival reconstruction from IMG_7952.jpeg. The printed historical number 1-800-663-3219 is reproduced as source text, not presented as an active contact. Gray frame, cream stock and blue lettering are approximate. The serif label and numerals use fitted URW Bookman Demi outlines after a multi-family comparison; the society name uses Nimbus Sans Regular. Exact original fonts are unconfirmed.
